name: Messiah
overview: The Bible reveals the Messiah as the promised Anointed One who would come to save God's people, fulfilling ancient prophecies such as the virgin birth foretold in Isaiah 7:14 and the birthplace in Bethlehem described in Micah 5:2. In the New Testament, Jesus is identified as the Messiah, the Christ, who alone is the way to the Father and the source of truth and life, as affirmed in John 1:41, John 4:25, and John 14:6. These verses collectively emphasize the divine origin, fulfillment of prophecy, and exclusive role of Jesus as the Savior.
